capability_dimensions.label: REASONING
capability_dimensions.description: Ability to analyze, infer, resolve ambiguity and sustain useful reasoning.

capability_dimensions.label: CODING
capability_dimensions.description: Ability to produce, modify, understand and debug software.

capability_dimensions.label: SCIENTIFIC_METHODOLOGICAL
capability_dimensions.description: Ability to interpret evidence and evaluate scientific or methodological correctness.

capability_dimensions.label: WRITING_EDITORIAL
capability_dimensions.description: Ability to preserve meaning and produce clear, coherent and well-structured prose.

capability_dimensions.label: TOOL_USE
capability_dimensions.description: Ability to use tools reliably, interpret their results and carry work through operational steps.

capability_dimensions.label: TRANSLATION_MULTILINGUAL
capability_dimensions.description: Ability to translate faithfully across languages while preserving semantics, terminology and register.

translation_multilingual.reason: Translation quality changes real routing decisions and must not be approximated solely from writing_editorial.

orchestration_dimension.reason: Real routing experiments must first show that the existing dimensions cannot distinguish suitable orchestration models reliably.

model_capability_classes.label: EXECUTION_GENERALIST
model_capability_classes.intent: A strong general-purpose model optimized for actually doing technical work.

task_level_guidance.scope: L0, L1 and L2, plus much of L3
task_level_guidance.guidance: Escalate because of reasoning difficulty, not merely because work is large or long.

usage_guidance: This is not a cheap, weak or low-intelligence class.
It should be capable of independently completing ordinary professional engineering work and making ordinary implementation judgments.
Do not escalate solely because many files exist, the task is long or the output is large.

model_capability_classes.label: ORCHESTRATION_SYNTHESIS
model_capability_classes.intent: A model particularly suited to maintaining intent and coherence across long-running, multi-stage work.

task_level_guidance.scope: L2 and L3, and sometimes L4 when difficulty is primarily synthesis rather than specialist domain judgment
task_level_guidance.guidance: Use when the main question is what is happening across the whole project, what should happen next and how to preserve intended structure and meaning.

usage_guidance: Do not treat this class as automatically superior for coding or scientific adjudication.
Orchestration work requires an explicit execution budget, explicit stop conditions, worker/reviewer serialization, bounded independent review and human escalation when the budget is exhausted.
Independent specialist review is valuable precisely because it is independent, but independence does not imply recursive authority over task scope.

model_capability_classes.label: DEEP_TECHNICAL_REASONER
model_capability_classes.intent: A high-capability escalation class for technically difficult problems where additional reasoning depth is likely to materially improve the result.

task_level_guidance.scope: L3 and L4, plus selected L5 technical work
task_level_guidance.guidance: Use when the ordinary execution model lacks sufficient reasoning margin or the problem is intrinsically difficult.

usage_guidance: Do not select merely because the task is long, many files are involved, the task looks important or the model is more prestigious.

model_capability_classes.label: SCIENTIFIC_METHODOLOGICAL_SPECIALIST
model_capability_classes.intent: A specialist class where domain judgment and correctness of interpretation are primary.

task_level_guidance.scope: Usually L4; L5 where consequences or difficulty justify it
task_level_guidance.guidance: Domain judgment and correctness of interpretation take priority over mechanical preparation.

usage_guidance: Another model may extract claims and candidate evidence.
The specialist adjudicates the claims and evidence.
An execution model may apply straightforward remediation.
The specialist reviews scientifically meaningful deltas when needed.
Independence may be a hard task constraint when the reviewer must operate separately from the model that produced the reviewed artifact.
Session independence is a policy concept only and is not implemented in Scarcity Router yet.

model_capability_classes.label: TRANSLATION_EDITORIAL_SPECIALIST
model_capability_classes.intent: A specialist class for high-fidelity translation where semantic preservation, terminology, register and editorial quality materially matter.

task_level_guidance.scope: L2 for ordinary translation; L3-L4 for technical, scientific, legal or publication-quality translation
task_level_guidance.guidance: Translation quality is a genuine capability concern and is not inferred solely from general writing quality.

usage_guidance: The same model may belong simultaneously to this class and another specialist class.

task_levels.name: routine
task_levels.description: Well-defined, low-ambiguity work with obvious expected behavior.

task_levels.name: standard
task_levels.description: Normal professional work requiring understanding and some reasoning.

task_levels.name: advanced
task_levels.description: Substantial reasoning, implementation complexity, debugging, ambiguity resolution or architecture.

task_levels.name: expert
task_levels.description: Subtle, high-value work where mistakes materially matter, including difficult implementation, methodological review or scientific interpretation.

task_levels.name: critical
task_levels.description: Work requiring the strongest suitable available capability because errors are especially costly or reasoning is genuinely frontier-level.
